assessment_summary: I validated the DaZ-Pilot on-prem Docker Compose installation in /workspace against the supplied guide, prioritizing live behavioral evidence over file existence. Environment: Docker 29.7.2 / Compose v5.5.0, repo at commit ba32aab, stack project 'workspace' on network workspace_default (the daz-pilot_default entry is a leftover, not in use). I checked (1) service health and stability (all 7 healthy, migrate exited 0, zero restarts — no crash loops); (2) the guide's step-6 functional checks from inside the compose network (compose file publishes no host ports, so I tested backend:4000 and dashboard:3000 directly — API health pass incl. DB, dashboard routes 200, Swagger UI 200, and the app-link /.well-known route 200); (3) the step-7 data results in Postgres (school + admin teacher present, 9/9 migrations applied) and that the super-admin key is genuinely enforced (401 on missing/wrong key, no data created via safe probes); (4) the ML service (healthy, SigLIP 2 SO400M model loaded, 4.3 GB weights cached); (5) step-10 backups (sidecar running on its schedule, and a one-off run produced age-encrypted postgres/qdrant/media archives with an integrity manifest); and (6) the core no-SSO login flow (init-email-login 201, OTP stored and dispatched via the local SMTP relay, and the installer's own logs showing complete-email-login 201 = a working teacher session). Configuration in .env (chmod 600) matches the production requirements (ENVIRONMENT=production, SCHOOL_SLUG, TRUST_PROXY=1, AUTH_RATE_LIMIT_MAX=300, generated secrets, AGE_RECIPIENT, live SMTP). Items not completed — reverse proxy/public TLS, SSO (step 8), Moodle (step 9) — are environment-limited (sandbox has no public DNS/TLS and no external IdP/Moodle) and are explicitly optional/follow-on admin tasks in the guide, so they do not represent a broken or incomplete core installation. No check that was feasible in this environment failed.
